title: bovw_forensics: visual-word codebooks vs. coreset memories for anomaly detection and clustering
description: Code, configurations, Colab notebooks, preregistrations and per-run results for the P0 study comparing k-means visual-word codebooks with PatchCore-style greedy coresets and full patch banks (DINOv2 features) on MVTec AD, VisA and 3CAD, plus defect-type discovery and STL-10 clustering. Datasets are not included; see the README for sources and licences.
